overview.statement: Mobeeli (pre-launch parts marketplace / trust infrastructure for Indonesia's $5.3B automotive aftermarket) needs a public marketing website before launch. Today there is no web presence: parts shops invited to the Early Adaptor program have nowhere to register interest, buyers cannot ask to be notified at launch, and investors have no page that explains the product or lets them request the deck. The full design already exists as a reviewed Claude Design prototype (landing page + join-waitlist wizard, EN/ID); it must be turned into a real, deployed website with a working waitlist funnel.
overview.impact: Without the site, the Early Adaptor program cannot capture the momentum from field sales (shops signed on paper have no digital follow-up channel); the 0%-for-first-300-shops promo has no registration funnel; investor outreach lacks a credible public face; and the 2026 launch marketing has no destination URL.

in_scope: Landing page — full approved section stack
